## Goals

<a id="CitedNotCopied"></a>

### A published value is cited, not copied

`CitedNotCopied` · `src/product.ts:22`

A value that a standard, a registry or an algorithm publishes (an HTTP status, the pattern of a date, a constant of a generator) is written once, with its source; a body receives it instead of writing it.

<a id="KnownDesigns"></a>

### Known designs, named

`KnownDesigns` · `src/product.ts:29`

The technical choices of a product follow designs described elsewhere; each one is named once, with where it is described and the shape it asks of a choice that follows it.

- Served by: [Abstract Factory](patterns.md#AbstractFactory), [Adapter](patterns.md#Adapter), [Bridge](patterns.md#Bridge), [Repository](patterns.md#Repository), [Strategy](patterns.md#Strategy), [Version 0.1.0](releases.md#R0_1_0)

<a id="RealizedOnce"></a>

### Ports of the platform, realized once

`RealizedOnce` · `src/product.ts:36`

What a product needs of a platform (a page that loads, a voice, a place to keep a choice) is a port, and its realizations on each platform are written once; a product binds, in each environment, the one that answers there.

- Served by: [The device's services, as ports](platform.md#DeviceAsPorts), [A component in a browser starts with its page](platform.md#StartsWithThePage), [Version 0.1.0](releases.md#R0_1_0)

<a id="SharedOperations"></a>

### Shared operations instead of literals

`SharedOperations` · `src/product.ts:15`

What a body would otherwise write itself (the first element, a count, the empty text) is an operation of an algebraic structure, named once, with the laws it keeps.

- Served by: [Counts](algebra.md#Counts), [Sequences](algebra.md#Sequences), [Texts](algebra.md#Texts), [Types of values](algebra.md#ValueTypes), [Version 0.1.0](releases.md#R0_1_0)
